The acciedent on the highway caused a long traffic jam.
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"acciedent"** is misspelled and does not exist in proper English. The correct spelling of the word is "accident."
 
• **"Accident"** refers to an unexpected and unintended event, often causing damage or harm. (दुर्घटना)
 
 
• **Example:** The accident on the highway caused a long traffic jam.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.
